verdict.rationale: Crossmint publishes an extensive, structured public REST API covering wallets, agent payments, checkouts, onramp/offramp, with interactive browser-testable reference docs and code-level quickstarts explicitly aimed at agents driving the API programmatically (create wallets, delegate signers, pay via x402/MPP, checkout). This is well beyond what a typical product exposes for AI-native/programmatic control. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of API stability/quality.
